Disruptive discussion today at the #SDG7 Action Forum on the session Digitalization of the Energy Sector ⚡️ organized by my friend Andrei Covatariu. We spoke about how digitalization is transforming the energy landscape and accelerating the transition we urgently need. 

But digitalization alone is not enough. We must embed social and environmental dimensions into every digital strategy. This means designing data-driven solutions that address inequality, ensuring investments reach developing countries. I also discussed how by leveraging #digital, we can provide real-time insights, de-risk projects, and make clean energy investments more attractive to financiers—ultimately channeling resources where they are most needed.

As we scale digital innovations, robust governance frameworks are essential. These frameworks must ensure transparency, address ethical concerns, and prevent data bias. Strong regulatory standards will guide AI on our transition pathways — guaranteeing that digital innovations benefit everyone equally.

How we can fully harness the triptych of digital, data, and AI in advancing our energy systems? 👉 bit.ly/SEH-Energy-Digital
